children: Australian shares were expected to open lower on Tuesday, likely weighed by mining and gold stocks on the back of weaker commodity prices, while a spike in oil prices and hotter U.S. inflation data firmed Federal Reserve rate hike bets.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.1%, a 0.2-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark ended up 0.1% on Monday.
